              授業科目の学習・教育目標

              キーワード
              学習・教育目標

              1.The Subject “Industry”
2.Industry in Society
3.Each Area in Industry
4.Industry and Education
5.The Course of Study

              The teacher in charge of “industry” is required to have basic knowledge of each area of industry. This course covers the overview of each area of industry, the acquisition of basic knowledge of each area of industry, the significance of industry in current society, environmental problems, and energy problems. Finally students will be required to have the foundation of practice to resolve proactively, rationally and ethically.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This course will take mechanical engineering, mechatronics, information engineering, architecture, civil engineering, and industrial chemistry. In each area, students understand basic knowledge and the relationship between each area and society.

              教科書および参考書・リザーブドブック

              None.

              履修に必要な予備知識や技能

              To have a willingness to obtain a teacher license of “Industry”.
